footer.text: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with the FIA, Formula 1 or any team; names, photos and marks belong to their owners. Sources: FIA stewards' documents (fia.com, each row links to its PDF) and OpenF1 (openf1.org) for driver photos and team colours. Decision and fact texts are shown in the original English.

disclaimer.title: Before you continue
disclaimer.body: Stewards' Room is an informational and analysis tool for journalists and fans of the sport. It shows real data taken directly from the FIA stewards' official documents, plus OpenF1 data. We completely condemn abuse and harassment, online or offline, of drivers, stewards, F1 officials or anyone in the sport. This information exists to better understand decisions and help improve the sport we love, not to attack anyone. If the site is used to harass the people who appear in it, it will be shut down permanently.
disclaimer.stewards.title: About the stewards' data
disclaimer.stewards: The stewards are officials doing a job. Their decisions are public record, shown here only so they can be analysed and understood. Harassment of any individual will not be tolerated.
